title: Add to Home Screen
description: Runs like an app and can receive background push notifications.
alreadyInstalled: Already added to your Home Screen
alreadyInstalledHint: Background push notifications are delivered normally.
mobileOnlyNote: On mobile browsers, background push (with the browser closed) only arrives when the app is installed on the Home Screen.

ios.step1: Tap the <chip>Share</chip> button at the bottom of Safari
ios.step2: Scroll down the menu and choose <chip>Add to Home Screen</chip>
ios.step3: Tap Add in the top-right corner and the Malang Budget icon appears on your Home Screen
ios.step4: Open the app from the Malang Budget icon on your Home Screen, then tap Turn on notifications in notification settings

android.promptHint: Tap the button below to open the Add to Home Screen dialog.
android.step1: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right corner of Chrome
android.step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen
android.step3: Open the app from the Malang Budget icon on your Home Screen, then turn on notifications

desktop.mobileOnly: Background push only matters on mobile. Please open this page on a mobile device.

unknown: Couldn't detect your browser. Please try again on a mobile device.
